- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is 596.24 billion INR, with a gross margin of 45.9% and an EBITDA margin of 27.8%.
- The company that contributes the most to revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with 337.3 billion INR, while the one that needs attention is Wipro Consumer Care India due to its lower EBITDA margin of 17%.
- Margins are 45.9% for gross margin and 27.8% for EBITDA margin.
- Working capital as of 2025-12-01 is influenced by DSO days of 121 and DPO days of 405.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre US10_PECS with a revenue change of 49.52 billion INR and 86.4% share of total change, SAP product sales (GL 41000000) excluding entity 310 Wipro Consumer Care India - South (310), profit centre US10_PECS with a revenue change of 41.49 billion INR and 72.4% share of total change, and SAP product sales (GL 41000000) excluding entity 310 Wipro Consumer Care India - South (310), entity USC1 Wipro Consumer Care International - US Corporate (USC1), profit centre US10_PECS, profit centre US10_PEML, profit centre US10_PEMS, profit centre US10_PLX with a revenue change of 22.13 billion INR and 38.6% share of total change.
